 WBBL 2026: Match 29, HH W vs ST W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Sydney Thunder Women?. (Photo Source: WBBL & FanCode) Hobart Hurricanes Women will take on Sydney Thunder Women in the 29th match of the Women's Big Bash League 2026 on Friday, November 20, at Bellerive Oval in Hobart. 
 The Hurricanes are going through a disappointing campaign, having lost all seven of their matches so far. They are languishing at the bottom of the points table without a point and will be desperate to register their first win of the season.  
 Sydney Thunder Women, meanwhile, have had a mixed campaign, winning three and losing four of their seven matches.

 Probable Top Performers from HH W vs ST W
 Probable Best Batter: Beth Mooney 
 Phoebe Litchfield will be an important player for Sydney Thunder at the top of the order. The left-handed batter has the ability to build an innings while maintaining a healthy scoring rate. She will be expected to provide her side with a solid start against a Hurricanes bowling attack that has struggled to deliver consistent performances. 
 Probable Best Bowler: Heather Graham  
 Heather Graham could be a key player for Hobart Hurricanes with the ball. The all-rounder has picked up nine wickets in seven matches this season at an average of 20.00. She will need to lead the bowling attack and find timely breakthroughs to give the Hurricanes a chance of restricting the Thunder.
